details.acc.p1: We are very near Stansted Airport, so there are lots of hotels and short term rentals in the area. We recommend booking early as it is a UK weekend holiday.
details.acc.p2: Camping on-site is also available but let us know in your RSVP if you'd like a pitch so we can organise.
details.acc.p3: We are a 30 minute train ride from central London too, if you wish to stay there. See "How to get there" for more information.
details.dress.p1: Country formal. Think a bit fancy, summer dresses, linen suits and of course, Kilts encouraged.
details.dress.p2: Some things you might want consider bringing: a change of comfy shoes (there will be games and a Ceilidh) and layers if the nights are looking cold. We are hoping to be as outside as possible. Please check the weather forecast in the days before.
details.gifts.p: Truely, and cliché, but your presence is the only gift we need so please no presents!
details.kids.p1: We’re keeping our celebration to close friends and family, so invitations are addressed by name and only those listed are invited.
details.kids.p2: For those with kids, as much as we love them and will miss them, we’re keeping the day adults only.
faq.1.a: Please arrive from 3:30pm and be seated by 3:50pm — the ceremony begins promptly at 4:00pm.
faq.2.a: Yes — the barn and orchard are step-free, with accessible parking near the entrance. Let us know if you need anything specific.
faq.3.a: If a plus-one has been included, it will say so on your invitation and on the RSVP form.
faq.4.a: There's a space for this on the RSVP form — just let us know and we'll make sure the kitchen is aware.
faq.5.a: Yes, free parking is available in the north field, a short walk from the barn.
faq.6.a: If it rains, the ceremony moves into the barn — either way, we'll be married by 4:30pm.
faq.7.a: We'd love for you to be present rather than behind a screen — we'll have a photographer, and phones can come out from the reception onward.
faq.7.q: Can I take photos during the ceremony?
faq.8.a: Please reply by 1 April 2027 using the form below so we can finalise catering and seating.

prog.1.p: There will be drinks and music before the ceremony starts.
prog.2.p: Under the willows by the lake, weather REGARDLESS!!!
prog.4.p: We will sit down for sharing plates, wine, drinks and dessert. Speeches throughout.
prog.5.p: A few more games to work off the food, and a chance to relax and get ready for the Ceilidh.
prog.7.p: We will all be danced out so home time. Make sure you book your taxis in advance (no Ubers here).
rsvp.h: Let us know if you can make it
rsvp.p: We can't wait to celebrate with you. Please reply by the date below so we can finalise catering and seating.
travel.car.p2: Free on-site parking is available in the north field — follow signs from the main gate. Please arrange a designated driver or taxi for the evening, as country lanes are unlit.
travel.train.p1: The nearest station is Moreton-in-Marsh (20 minutes by taxi), with regular trains from London Paddington.
travel.train.p2: Let us know your arrival time on the RSVP form and we'll do our best to help coordinate lifts from the station.
